query:
select jsonb_build_object(
 'accounts',(select count(*) from garimpa.affiliate_account),
 'curation_global_orphans',(select count(*) from garimpa.product_curation c left join garimpa.app_user u on u.id=c.reviewed_by_app_user_id where c.reviewed_by_app_user_id is not null and u.id is null),
 'selection_global_orphans',(select count(*) from garimpa.editorial_selection s left join garimpa.app_user u on u.id=s.actor_app_user_id where s.actor_app_user_id is not null and u.id is null),
 'curation_old_fk',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'validated',convalidated,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid))) from pg_constraint where conrelid='garimpa.product_curation'::regclass and conname='product_curation_reviewer_tenant_fkey'),
 'selection_old_fk',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',conname,'validated',convalidated,'definition',pg_get_constraintdef(oid))) from pg_constraint where conrelid='garimpa.editorial_selection'::regclass and conname='editorial_selection_actor_app_user_id_tenant_id_fkey'),
 'old_m2_absent',to_regprocedure('garimpa.active_tenant(text)') is null,
 'new_curation_fk_absent',not exists(select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid='garimpa.product_curation'::regclass and conname='product_curation_reviewer_user_fkey'),
 'new_selection_fk_absent',not exists(select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid='garimpa.editorial_selection'::regclass and conname='editorial_selection_actor_user_fkey'),
 'history',(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('version',version,'name',name) order by version) from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where name in ('garimpa_account_context_and_membership','garimpa_affiliate_secret_bootstrap_rls','garimpa_curation_membership_author','garimpa_tenant_rls_scoped'))
) as author_repair_preflight;
